ValidationRule.description: Travel Voucher Monetary Value should be greater than 0
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Travel Vouchers"), NOT(ISBLANK(Monetary_Value__c)), OR( Monetary_Value__c < 10, MOD(Monetary_Value__c, 1) <> 0), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "New"), ISPICKVAL(Process_Status__c, "New")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Monetary Value should be at least $10 and rounded up to the nearest number
